messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2). p95 breached 500ms -> 1.2s, p99 > 2s. Page: @sara (oncall) <https://redwood.ops/alerts/2247001111|incident-2247001111> :rotating_light:

sara (oncall): acked. jumping in. any customer-facing incidents yet? :thinking_face:

mike: seeing elevated tail across both streaming and non-streaming routes. dashboards -> p95 ~ 480ms, p99 ~ 1.9-2.3s. throughput normal. no error spike.

anya: looks like streaming stall metric (stream_chunks_dropped) has a bump starting ~2247001050. probably related to KV-cache hot keys.

sara (oncall): good catch. can someone run a quick query on the tracer for longest tail requests? suggest grabbing top call stacks and routing decisions.

mike: running quick trace query now. output snippet:
```
trace_id: 0x8f12a3 - model: r-llama-13b-8k-quant - route: auto-lowcost -> fallback: r-llama-7b-4k
durations_ms: [p50: 120, p95: 480, p99: 2100]
top_step: kv_cache_fetch (median 10ms, p99 1400ms)
```

infra-bot: autoscale group us-west-2-serving scaled at 2247001090 (+3 nodes) due to cpu pressure on serving pool 'generational-1'.

sara (oncall): so KV-cache fetch spikes. could be cache miss storms or hot shards. switching to cache-bypass might reduce tail but increase token cost. thoughts?

lee: we should try routing traffic away from the faulty shard -> enable redistribution / soft-failover to other cache partitions. quick mitigation: change routing policy to prefer local-fixed instances and reduce max_batch to 4 to cut tail.

anya: agree. also enabling per-request prefix-KV warmup for top customers.

sara (oncall): ok short plan: 1) temporarily lower batching and prefer low-latency pool; 2) enable model-variant fallback to r-llama-7b for non-critical paths; 3) if p99 still >1.5s, enable cache-bypass. I'll apply 1 & 2 now.

mike: +1. applying routing override now:
```
PATCH /v1/config/routing/policies/active
{
  "policy": "prefer-low-latency",
  "max_batch": 4,
  "override_reason": "live p99 regression 2247001111"
}
```

incident-bot: Deploying routing override -> success (revision 23).

mike: enabling model fallback rule for /v1/generate non-authenticated traffic (non-critical):
```
POST /v1/config/model-fallbacks
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "fallback_chain": ["r-llama-13b-8k-quant","r-llama-7b-4k"],
  "priority": "latency"
}
```

incident-bot: Model fallback applied -> success.

anya: early telemetry: p95 dropping to ~300-350ms after policy change. p99 still at ~1.2s but trending down. streaming stalls count down 40% in the last 30s.

sara (oncall): good. please monitor for 10m and check customer-facing dashboards for degraded responses. notify support if any vocal customers. I'll prepare a short incident ticket.

lee: creating internal incident ticket: INC-2247001111. adding root-cause hypothesis: KV-cache hotspot causing long fetch latencies and increased serialization stall under specific request bundle patterns.

mike: small note: we saw a deployment to generational-1 pool earlier today ~2246999000. not sure if related but will correlate.

infra-bot: recorded cluster scaling events and allocation logs: <https://redwood.ops/logs/allocs?from=2246999000&to=2247001170>.

anya: follow-ups to add to the ticket: - heapmap of hot keys, - KV-shard resharding once lower traffic, - performance test for sequential KV fetch patterns, - revisit safe defaults for max_batch under high-KV conditions.

sara (oncall): handing off to @lee for overnight watch. I'm going to unassign on-call in 10m. if p99 spikes back >2s, page SRE primary.

lee: taking it. will run KV heatmap job and leave scaling override in place for 30m. setting watch-alert: p99 > 1.5s will reopen page.

mike: adding quick rollback pointer: to revert routing override run:
```
DELETE /v1/config/routing/policies/active?rev=23
```

incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact flag set to 'potential' (no confirmed errors, elevated latency only).

anya: recording a short blurb for support: "We observed elevated tail latency affecting some streaming sessions. We’ve applied routing and model-fallback mitigations; monitoring for recovery. No errors observed."

sara (oncall): thanks all. reactions: :white_check_mark: :coffee:

lee: logging final note before takeover: monitoring healthy, will update ticket with KV heatmap results and any reshard plans.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (auto) - last activity 2247001170 unless re-opened by pager or mention.
